findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a few broken tiles under the three compartment sink within the bar area. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspector that the relevant repairs will be done. Ensure that the broken tiles are replaced providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Ice machine was observed to contain an accumulation of mold.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure ice machine is cleaned regularly.

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean

4-601.11: The pizza ovens were observed to have an accumulation of food and grease debris. Ensure these surfaces are removed from the oven and put through a wash, rinse, sanitize cycle. Perform these actions at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of the debris.

4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Open cans of Redbull and orange juice were observed in the sliding door cooler. Once cans are opened leftovers need to be stored properly. Cans of Redbull may be covered with plastic wrap, while cans of acidic drinks (i.e. juices - orange, pineapple, tomato, etc.) need to be stored in a proper, reusable container. The cans for acidic drinks are not meant to be used for storage once products are opened - metals/metallic flavors can leak into foods. Cans of Redbull & orange juice were discarded during the inspection. Properly store and protect foods at all times.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - Chest freezer had frost buildup inside. Rust was beginning to form on a few locations inside the freezer and on the outside of the lid. Defrost the freezer and re-surface areas with rust formation. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) inside popcorn machine (grease/food debris); B) tray of pizza oven (food debris); C) inside ice machine (mold); & D) soda gun holder (mold). Clean and sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of food, mold, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) top of chest freezer (food debris/rust formation); B) tracks & shelves of sliding door cooler (debris); C) walkin cooler shelves; D) floor fan; E) inside unused fridge/freezer (debris/mold); F) outside of pizza oven (between tray and waste pan); G) bottom inside/seals around doors of beer cooler (mold/debris); & H) black waste basket at bar 3 part sink (buildup). Clean non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text: 750.1060 - A) Women's room handsink was slow draining. Get the handsink checked/repaired. B) Mopsink was soiled/slow draining due to grimy buildup. Also, there was a leak at the plumbing underneath the basin, and only one faucet handle worked. Get the plumbing repaired so the mopsink does not leak, has hot and cold water (both handles of faucet work), and it drains properly. All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof

The wall next to the door was damaged, so light was visible through the wall to the left of the door as well. Repair the back door and the wall by the door. Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects. Provide tight fitting, vermin proof doors and walls. Check all doors and make necessary repairs.
